text: Navin Fluorine International Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that the officials of Navin Fluorine International Limited ('the Company') will be interacting with Analysts / Investors on November 16, 2026 and November 17, 2026. The details are enclosed. Presentation to be made at the Meetings is enclosed. Discussions will be based on publicly available information. Kindly note that changes may happen due to exigencies on the part of Host / Company. This intimation is also being made available on the Company's website at www.nfil.in

Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that the audio recording of the Company s Earnings Call held today i.e. on October 30, 2026, regarding discussion on operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 & H1 of FY 2026-27) is available on the Company s website at https://www.nfil.in/uploads/investor/financial/nfil-audio-earnings-call-q2fy-2026-27.mp3 This intimation is also being made available on the Company s website at www.nfil.in.
